the 2400 search window is one candidate wide

why: EXPECTED UNCAUGHT, and this is an argument about the code rather than about the suite.  Both operands of the subtraction have already been masked with V22_SYM_QUAD, so each is a multiple of four and bits 1:0 of the difference are clear whatever the borrow does.  Masking four bits and masking two therefore give the same value for every possible pair, and the index that follows is identical.  0x0f is written because 0x0f is what the object encodes (`and $0xf,%eax` at 0x8878a and 0x88641), not because anything can tell the two apart.
